description: This file defines a helper class 'GeneratorHelper' with static methods for recursively removing directories and copying files/directories, used for filesystem operations in a project.

classes.name: GeneratorHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for recursive directory removal and copying.

methods.name: rmdir
methods.description: Removes a directory and its contents recursively.

methods.name: copyRecursive
methods.description: Copies files and directories recursively from source to destination.
